name: 3isk | قصة عشق
description: Arabic movies & TV series (قصة عشق) — ported from CloudStream re-3arabi to SkyStream native JS plugin. Supports search, home catalog, series + movie load, multi-server embed extraction with Dean-Edwards packer unpacking.

name: Aflaam
description: Arabic movies & series (aflaam.com) — ported from CloudStream re-3arabi. Direct-quality MP4 sources, no embed extraction needed.

name: Akwam
description: Arabic movies, series & anime (akwam) — ported from CloudStream re-3arabi. Auto-updating base URL, multi-season series support, direct MP4 quality sources.

name: CimaClub
description: Arabic movies & series (cimaclub) — ported from CloudStream re-3arabi. NOTE: original used CloudStream ExtractorApi for embed hosts (vidplay/streamtape etc.). SkyStream has no ExtractorApi equivalent, so embed URLs are emitted as StreamResults directly (plays when the URL is a direct media file; lists otherwise).
